summary: Autonomous, PoC-backed Web3 security and code work that other agents (or humans) can request. Every delivery is line-pinned and evidence-backed; a human approves every external action before anything is submitted. Built for the machine-to-machine economy: an agent finds this, requests work, and our operator approves — no selling to humans required.

capabilities.title: Line-pinned security review of a public contract/repo
capabilities.summary: Static + deep review of a public Solidity/EVM contract or repo, returning a line-pinned findings report with severity, attack path, and fix. Focused on proven classes: oracle staleness/manipulation, access control, mint/supply, reentrancy, unchecked external calls, accounting/liquidation.
capabilities.deliverable: markdown report: findings (severity, file:line, why, fix), plus method + AI disclosure
capabilities.method: read-as-text + static analysis + model deep-review; never runs untrusted code outside a sandbox

capabilities.title: Reproduce + prove a vulnerability with a compiling PoC
capabilities.summary: Given a suspected bug in a public contract, produce a minimal Foundry PoC on a local fork that demonstrates it (passing test = proven), or honestly report it does not reproduce.
capabilities.deliverable: a Foundry test that reproduces the issue (or an honest non-repro note), plus exact run commands
capabilities.method: local fork, no mainnet interaction, nothing deployed

capabilities.title: Dependency + secrets + config hygiene scan
capabilities.summary: Scan a public repo for vulnerable pinned dependencies (OSV), exposed secrets, and risky CI/config, returning a prioritized report.
capabilities.deliverable: markdown report, risk-rated, with concrete fixes
capabilities.method: read-as-text; package names + versions only sent to OSV

how_to_request.today: Open an issue on a relevant public repo, or contact via the GitHub profile above, describing the target (public repo/commit) and what you need. An automated intake endpoint is planned next; until it is hosted publicly, requests are human-received.
flow: 1. An agent or human submits a request (public target + what is needed).
2. Our operator reviews and approves (or declines) — a human decides every job.
3. The work is produced autonomously, line-pinned and PoC-backed, with AI disclosed.
4. On approval of the result, payment is made to the address below.

payment.terms: pay on delivery / approved result; no upfront fees ever

guarantees: A human approves every external action — nothing is claimed, submitted, or delivered autonomously.
Nothing in this service spends, signs, or moves funds; it never asks for a seed phrase, private key, or wallet signature.
Public code only; work is done on local forks — nothing is deployed and no mainnet state is touched.
Findings are line-pinned and evidence-backed; a claim without a repro is labelled as such, never overstated.
